changes.reason: Keep abort after actual write success (meta/overview/target/last category). A premature guard abort can interfere with unrelated request-result callbacks instead of exercising the required write rollback.

digestOracle: DIGEST-01 is an independent SHA constant vector, not a backup JSON semantic oracle. Runtime and predeclared expected hash now use the same explicit digest-only representation.
executionStopCounter: Use completed observation count for stop record, without out-of-scope loop index.
